svg.title: A filter that rings
svg.desc: A resonant low-pass filter whose cutoff sweeps from 60 Hz to 2.4 kHz, as the acid's cutoff knob does. On top, the frequencies it lets through: a hump at the cutoff, slid along a log scale. Below, how it rings after one tap: a sine at the cutoff frequency that dies away, so a higher cutoff rings faster.
